t: This is Squire's Mount, a street in Hampstead, in the London Borough of Camden. Sir Robin Brook lived here. He was a British merchant banker and a director of the Bank of England, and he is also recorded as a fencer, born in 1908. His wife, Helen Brook, founded the Brook Advisory Centres. The material I have is brief, so that is the extent of what I can tell you about the street's connections.
